previous_statement: Let e_1 be the first coordinate column and put B=Xe_1^* in M_n tensor A (X zero-padded to the first column) and A_0=B^dagger=e_1X^dagger (X^dagger zero-padded to the first row). Under the canonical rectangular-matrix inclusions of the self-adjoint operator space underlying the extended epsilon-C*-algebra, zero-padding is isometric, so ||B||=||X||_{n,1}=r and ||A_0||=||B||=r. Since X has entries in S_{P,Q}, entrywise amplification places B in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}=S_{P_n,Q_n}; dagger places A_0 in S_{Q_n,P_n}. Thus (A_0,B), with outer projections Q_n,Q_n and middle projection P_n, is a compatible square amplified rectangular pair for lem-compcb-rectangular-product.
new_statement: Let e_1 be the first coordinate column and define B=Xe_1^* and A_0=B^dagger=e_1X^dagger. From X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, entrywise zero-padding yields only B in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}; dagger yields only A_0 in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}. None of def-hcb-datum, def-column-hilbert-corner, lem-compcb-rectangular-product, or lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm identifies these spaces with S_{P_n,Q_n} and S_{Q_n,P_n}. Hence compatibility of (A_0,B) for lem-compcb-rectangular-product is not established under this shard's exact allowed inputs, and the former affirmative compatibility claim is withdrawn.
